en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing a tree‑lined promenade and a railing in the foreground, with several uniformed men walking along the path. Behind the avenue of trees rises a large historic church with a tall central tower and a steep gabled roof, and to its right a robust rectangular tower that appears to be part of a castle or fortified complex. The overall scene looks like an early‑20th‑century European cityscape taken from a park or embankment.
